WildSpark 2.2.70 updates WildFire Kit and WildGroups for WoW Forever.

- Update the embedded WildFire Kit to 1.11.1, including cleanup for stale per-zone camp channels and updated weapon-stone actions.
- Preserve WildSpark's own icon artwork, Happy Camper opt-out defaults, built-in channel ordering protections, and cleanup for retired WildLayer channels.
- Update WildGroups to upstream 2.5.0: dungeon and raid favorites, per-character filter migration, richer Quests & Zones rows, opening on the player's own listing, and protected-action fixes.
- Package and GitHub workflow checks passed. Live in-game behavior was not tested.
